title: Retention-to-Renewal Conversion Opsheet — scenario lab
summary: Lab-style tracker for running multiple renewal probability scenarios across accounts by combining engagement signals, contract timing, and intervention actions. Designed to feed QBRs and renewal sprint planning.
content:
Scenario | Customer | Account Owner | Contract End | ARR | Renewal Window Start | Time to Renewal (days) | Model Likelihood (%) | Confidence Low (%) | Confidence High (%) | Conservative Prob (%) | Upsell Potential ($) | Churn Signals | Last Touch | Next Best Action | Priority | Escalation | Notes | Link
